task: Delete the agent's chat/UI surface so an agent is a terminal session only, and make the Material Icon Theme the sole, colour, unchangeable icon theme.
acceptanceCriteria: no code path can put an agent into a chat or UI mode
the ACP stack the chat depended on is gone from the workspace
file and folder icons come from the Material Icon Theme in colour
no user-facing control can change the icon theme
file name matching is case-insensitive so Dockerfile and README.MD resolve
the workspace compiles and every touched suite is green
blastRadius: Four crates removed from the workspace graph, so anything depending on them fails to compile rather than silently degrading. The icon-theme resolve path is shared with colour-theme resolution, so the lock was placed in ThemeRegistry rather than in settings resolution to keep colour themes untouched. The icon_theme settings key must stay present in default.json because from_settings unwraps unconditionally and a missing key is a startup panic. Extension-supplied icon themes now register but cannot take effect.
contracts: ThemeRegistry::get_icon_theme(name) no longer honours name — every caller resolves to the default
AgentViewMode lost its Chat variant; mode_from_name defaults to Terminal
IconSource gained EmbeddedColor, routing embedded SVGs through img() instead of svg()
settings_content agent.rs kept intact — project::agent_server_store needs AllAgentServersSettings for terminal mode
